title: The any-photo rung looks at a frame's next three photos together, and the ladder still places the same photos with the same verdicts
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm the test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A gallery tile the looker always rejects climbs through several any-photo placements; with the look-ahead on and off, the placed frames (source, asset, file hash), the ladder record and every verdict are the same.
Without the look-ahead each any-photo placement waits for its own fresh look; with it, only the first does, and every look taken ahead is a call record marked ahead for that frame.
No picture is asked twice, and the save's paid sum equals the cost of every look the provider answered, looks taken ahead included.

tests: the look-ahead keeps every photo, cut, rung and verdict of the ladder, and its looks are counted and paid
